next.reason: 1985: "The DATA RECORDS clause is an obsolete element in Standard COBOL because it is to be deleted from the next revision"; 2023: "No DATA RECORDS clause among the 13.4.5 file description entry rules or the 13.18 clauses; the clause was deleted". The DATA RECORDS clause was obsolete in 1985 and slated for deletion. No 2023 file description or clause candidate mentions it, so the feature is gone.
